Thanks for the ping, Ben. I pulled the signals and did a quick triage. TL;DR: holds recommended pending verification. Details: 

- Clustering: 7 unique accounts map to three IP ranges all originating from the same mobile ISP ASN (AS36561). Spike happened within a 90m window on 2027-05-01 14:00–15:30 UTC.
- Email domains: 5/7 use short-lived disposable domains (examples: mail7x.com, tempmailhq.net). The remaining two use gmail variants with similar local-parts.
- Device signals: rotating user-agent strings but identical GPU/hardware hashes in KV cache (likely simulated or reused device images).
- Token patterns: each account issued heavy identical prompt batches (same payload sizes + identical system messages) — consistent with scripted stress tests or automated jobs.

Attached: device_signals.json (sampled fingerprints and UA strings). Screenshot attached showing signup cluster in the admin UI (screenshot-flag.png).

Recommendations:
1) Do not auto-top-up. Hold any cardless credit issuance for these accounts.
2) Request SynthLabs provide a corporate email or a verification call. If they can confirm a reachable billing contact and company domain, we can consider a manual conditional top-up (small amount).
3) If they insist on immediate credits and cannot verify, approve only after an identity/billing check tied to a corporate domain or PO.

I'll open INC-4521 and tag for deeper log pulls if product ops wants to escalate.
